title: Weinstein's government-funded training and official disinterest in his physics

plain: The mathematician Eric Weinstein says the US government paid for his training but now shows no interest in his physics. He says the Office of Naval Research, the Navy's science funding office, paid for his graduate studies, the National Science Foundation, a federal science funding agency, paid for his postdoctoral job, and he believes he was put on a Department of Energy grant, which he calls very unusual for a mathematician and says happened because the mathematician Isidor Singer had one. "None of those people have any interest whatsoever in what I'm saying," he says, which he finds "fascinating."
